title: NewtonX Launches B2B Synthetic Personas Built on Identity-Verified Professional Data
summary: NewtonX announced Synthetic Personas, which it describes as the first B2B synthetic solution in the industry: custom AI-powered simulations that combine a client's own research with NewtonX's identity-verified professional data, drawing on more than eight years of signals across 140+ industries. Personas are locked to the client's organization rather than shared through a marketplace, return both interview-style and survey-style outputs through a chat interface, and include reflection checks and citation tracing. NewtonX positions the product as complementary to primary research, not a replacement.
whyItMatters: Synthetic respondents are the sharpest test yet of how much expert input can be simulated; NewtonX is betting that verified human data is the prerequisite for making synthetic B2B research credible.
